- Retargeted `Service.Tests/Service.Tests.csproj` from `net10.0` to `net11.0`. Restore/build resolved `Mulse.Ui` at net11.0 and retained the five existing net10.0 library references; both `Mulse.ServiceDefaults` targets were built.

The final test-project build emitted no warnings from `Service.Tests`.
- Targeted .NET 11 tests passed: `NativeMessageFactTests`, `ReferencePickerUiTests`, and `XmlCustomFunctionUiTests` — 100 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- Visual Studio `run_build` and `run_tests` report stale framework/dependency build errors for `Mulse.ServiceDefaults`; CLI `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` succeeded for the test project. The CLI test build still reports existing warnings in unmodified `Mulse.CompatibilityPack` and `Service`; these are outside this subtask's touched project and are tracked for later solution validation.
- Full suite execution is deferred to `03.03.02-behavior-tests`.
